title: KAITO — The Ones Close To Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me practice my singing, Rin, Len. I feel like I managed to put more feeling into my song than before.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It was good practice for us, too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah! Len, we should go find Miku soon.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, right! We promised to go look over that newly born SEKAI with her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: See you around, KAITO! Let's sing again soon!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, see you.
se_run_men_001_1
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
A new SEKAI, huh...
Maybe I'll go look around a SEKAI, too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which one should I look in on...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm, if Len and the others are visiting a new SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe I'll go check out those other SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm interested to see how my counterparts have been doing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Hmm, which version of me should I check in with first?
I was just thinking about Ichika and the others. They're pros now, after all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That was my...or rather, the voice of another version of me from a SEKAI?
I'm not wearing this. It's so lame—
Miku, can I ask you a favor?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, and again... From over here?
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It was right around here...
Whatever...at least he's keeping quiet.
In many ways, it's thanks to all of you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There! The voices came from this fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But why would my voices be coming from a fragment like this?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Somehow I feel as though it's calling to me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can't say I'm not curious. Let's have a look.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This must be the SEKAI of that fragment of a feeling...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah! There are pictures of SEKAI versions of me on these pillars.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: These are...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I feel emotions coming from each one. Are they the emotions of each KAITO shown here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's see... This is the me from Ichika and her friends' SEKAI, the band KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Ichika and her friends have gone pro.)
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Life as professional musicians won't be easy...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But after seeing that show, I'm sure that they'll be—)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ah, KAITO!
What're you up to?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was just thinking about Ichika and the others. They're pros now, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And that's why you were looking up at the stars?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I get it! You were wishing on a shooting star for everything to go well for them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hahaha! You're so cute sometimes, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? No, not exactly...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, did you find KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! You gotta hear what KAITO was doing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Uh, hey, I wasn't...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? KAITO was wishing on a shooting star?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm sure Rin's just jumping to conclusions. Look how fast KAITO's shaking his head.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, the truth is...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Those were the emotions of the me from that SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I could feel his relief, as well as his faith in his friends.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. That KAITO isn't always the best at using his words, so it's nice that he has friends who can grasp what he's feeling.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Does that mean that each of these picture-like things contains the emotions of a KAITO from one SEKAI or another?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe I'll have a look at some others. Let's see...hmm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, this is the DJ me. It looks like he's helping clean up, but what is that around his neck...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm pretty curious. Let's have a look.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course when the ice cream goes missing, you're the culprit, KAITO.
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah...sorry. I haven't seen that flavor much before, so I couldn't help myself. Were you...really looking forward to it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Normally she'd scold me a lot more than this... What's different today?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Could it be she's gone past anger into pure despair?!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry, MEIKO! I didn't realize you were looking forward to it so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm really, truly sorry! This time, I really have reflected on my actions!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you really sorry?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I am, I am! Look, I'll do whatever you ask! Want me to make lunch? Should I clean the cafe?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Fine...Help me clean the cafe, then.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, you got it! Your wish is my command!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't sound very apologetic.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I am, I am! I promise!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yet somehow you never seem to learn your lesson... Alright, I've got an idea.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here. Put this signboard around your neck and let's get cleaning.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? What is this? “I ate all of MEIKO's ice cream”? I'm not wearing this. That's so lame—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Uh... I mean, sure. I'd be happy to...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Somehow I feel as though I've gotten used to seeing this KAITO looking apologetic...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I do wish he'd learn his lesson. But at the same time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: His freewheeling attitude is part of his unique charm.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The others around him don't seem to mind all that much, either.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe it's because it's that SEKAI specifically that everyone has such strong bonds of trust with one another?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thinking of it that way, maybe it's the kindness and support of those around them that allow the band me and the DJ me to be themselves so comfortably.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I see now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe all of “my” emotions gathered here are...
